title: Implement approved fonts, accessible auth screens and micro-interactions

Reconcile generic signup then screened sign-in, session-operation/SDK cleanup, font licensing/loading, media CSP and complete frontend evidence/documentation.

Late callbacks/SDK successes or failures cannot overwrite newer login/logout; SDK cache/storage and foreground refresh remain cleared after logout without duplicate provider logout

Native caregiver sessions use SecureStore with safe legacy cleanup; web localStorage residual XSS risk explicitly documented
Validated exact media/storage origins preserve existing gallery/audio under enforced CSP/SRI
Baseline FamilyMember type errors fixed accurately and existing profile/cache/navigation behavior preserved
Minimal worktree ESLint/Jest extension only for necessary globals/worktree scan exclusions
Meaningful auth/accessibility/security tests, typecheck, lint, web export and docs/auth-frontend.md handoff pass
